text: ポケモンに　あなを　ほらせて　きっと　また　わるだくみを　かんがえてるのよ！

structure.jp: ポケモンに　あなを　ほらせて
きっと　また　わるだくみを　かんがえてるのよ！
structure.en: surely they're plotting something wicked again!

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.span: ポケモンに　あなを　ほらせて
patterns.explanation: ほる 'dig' changed to ほらせる means to make someone dig, and the one made to do it takes に. ポケモンに　あなを　ほらせて = 'making Pokémon dig holes'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says something is going on right now, and てる is the shortened spoken form. かんがえてる = 'are thinking up'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives the feeling of explaining how things are, and のよ is a feminine way to say it firmly. かんがえてるのよ = 'they're plotting, I tell you'.
